- Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and manage a team of 12–15 consultants — Managers, Senior Associates, Associates, and Analysts — across concurrent engagements, building a high-performance culture.

- Capability Building: Develop the team’s depth on key strategy topics and the advisory craft — problem structuring, executive communication, business case development, and client navigation.

- Talent Management: Own staffing, performance feedback, and career development for the team; contribute to recruiting and strengthening the practice bench.

THE IDEAL PROFILE
- Consulting Pedigree: 10+ years in consulting, leading enterprise AI, technology, or intelligent automation engagements at a top-tier strategy, technology, or Big Four firm in a plus.

- Healthcare Fluency: Direct experience serving healthcare providers; command of healthcare economics and AI-relevant pain points across clinical, operational, and revenue cycle workflows strongly preferred.

- Executive Presence: Credible in a technical conversation with a CIO and a value conversation with a CFO in the same meeting; influential in a matrixed organization.

- Growth Mindset: A builder’s orientation — able to operate with ambiguity, contribute to net-new offerings, and convert white space into a repeatable practice motion.

ROLE REQUIREMENTS
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience; MBA or relevant advanced degree strongly preferred.
